title.value: Progressive Coarse-graining and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs)

TLDR.value: We provide an overview of various theories about deep neural network function, and forward an overarching summary inspired by Erik Hoel's Causal Emergence 2.0 framework.

abstract.value: We try to provide an overarching perspective on some of the research done in the last few years explaining the behaviour of deep neural networks (DNNs) when they are used to complete a variety of classification and prediction tasks. We start by providing an overview of several noteworthy papers on the fundamental properties of DNNs across different architectures and data regimes. We then forward our own integrated perspective of DNNs as progressive coarse-graining systems inspired by Erik Hoel's Causal Emergence 2.0 framework.
